about.why_p2: By participating in this program, you benefit from a simplified path to obtain your professional visa, as well as a grant to facilitate your installation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about the program

q1.q: Who can participate in this program?
q1.a: The program is aimed at qualified professionals aged 21 to 45, with a recognized diploma and at least 2 years of experience in their field. Priority sectors include healthcare, IT, engineering, and education.

q2.q: How much does it cost to participate in the program?
q2.a: Participation fees vary depending on the chosen country and your situation. They include administrative fees, personalized support and consular procedures. Contact us for a personalized quote. The international grant you will receive covers these fees largely.

q3.q: How long does the complete process take?
q3.a: On average, the complete process takes between 3 and 6 months, from application submission to visa obtainment. This time may vary by country and time of year.

q4.q: Can I choose the destination country?
q4.a: Yes, you can indicate your preferences among France, Belgium and Switzerland. We will advise you on the country most suited to your profile and professional goals.

q5.a: Yes, the initial residence permit is generally valid for 3 years and can be renewed if you maintain a professional activity in the host country. After 5 years, you can apply for a permanent resident permit.

q6.q: Can I come with my family?
q6.a: Yes, family reunification is possible. Your spouse and children can accompany you or join you later. Specific conditions apply by country.

q7.q: What happens if my application is refused?
q7.a: In case of refusal, we analyze the reasons and propose an action plan. You can generally appeal or submit a new application after correcting the problematic points.

q8.q: Do I already need to have a job offer?
q8.a: No, this program does not require a prior job offer. However, having professional contacts or leads in the host country can strengthen your file.
